channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Nov 13
item.description:
128 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Rocketpack added as a new piece of equipment.

Equipment & Gear

  • Rocketpack added as a new piece of equipment.
  • FPV Goggles let players control RC units while wearing them (battery‑dependent) and spawn a linked ComputerStation for distance handling.
  • Gun wear reduced from 1.0 to 0.75 per use, and turrets now display a second HP bar showing weapon condition plus an ammo counter, visible without powering off the turret.

AI & Drones

  • Scout drones patrol small monuments, raise alarms, and now feature a visible light, search behavior, and health values.
  • Guards now drop loot scaled by tier, and heavy units no longer cause client crashes on death.

Player Mechanics & Survival

  • Holding F while wounded lets players “give up”, accelerating time‑remaining and recovery‑chance drains; releasing F pauses the timer.
  • Flash grenades reworked with zone‑based flash and deafness, name‑tag hiding, adjusted damage radius, and shrapnel that adds bleed and shows visible streaks.

World & Loot

  • Entire trucks act as loot containers, can be looted, show health UI when broken, and have a reduced size for easier access.
  • Monuments no longer reset or respawn loot, all NPCs have been removed from the world, and the Outpost has been removed from the raid map.
  • Introduced a Tier 2 solo/duo Container Shelter prototype with a Tier 0 workbench and a destroyable door/shelter.
  • Hub now has its own arrival markers and you no longer see the map or death screen when arriving.

Economy & Shop

  • Supplies shop prices increased; every item now has a value and loot above‑made gear is accounted for.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Nov 12
item.description:
81 development commits

Combat & Weapons

  • Flamethrower now fires correctly in first‑person view.
  • High‑velocity ammo now ignores projectile protection from armor inserts and horse armor.
  • New Woolly Boots recipe (10 wool, 5 leather, 1 sewing kit) greatly reduces footstep and jump noise but lowers projectile protection.

Reviving & Healing

  • Reviving another player no longer resets their wounded timer; if the timer expires during a revive hold you stay down until release, but a full revive still succeeds.

Raiding & Loot

  • Safe pocket is now counted as carried inventory and the map is cleared after a raid.
  • Loot box opening delay reduced, allowing faster looting.

World & Spawns

  • Monument guard tiers rebalanced: weaker factions now spawn under scientists.
  • Beach spawn algorithm overhauled for fairer coverage, reduced monument check radius, and allows spawns on more coastlines and near oceans.
  • Airfield puzzle replaced with NPC mission: pressing tower button summons two chinook drops with scientists.
  • Catapult off‑map clipping bug fixed; players are no longer yeeted off the map by catapults.

Extraction & Map UI

  • Extraction balloons now display a countdown timer on the map and close one after another.

Quality of Life

  • Dropbox containers now align flush against walls, preventing mis‑placement of attached storage adapters.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Nov 11
item.description:
161 development commits

Transportation & Vehicles

  • Horse armor overhaul: rider protection removed, horse armor boosted, no speed penalty, heavy plates allowed, stamina drain added, and road signs gain 12 storage slots.
  • Helicopter handling improvements: smoother mounted input sequencing, fixed client ticking and bounce bugs for predicted helicopters at high latency.
  • Seamless vehicle clustering: nearby vehicles and players are grouped into server clusters, staying on a single server for consistent behavior.

Inventory, Loot & Economy

  • Main inventory size on the extraction map halved, tightening looting decisions.
  • Item UI now shows scrap value, letting you see loot worth at a glance.
  • Cargo ship loot pools rebalanced: containers now contain only tools, ammo/meds, or food, removing high‑tier weapons.

Base Building & World Interaction

  • Buildings placed near each other automatically merge into a single base, simplifying expansion.
  • Seamless servers now share a unified time of day, spawn full enemy waves beyond terrain borders, and allow shooting across server boundaries.
  • Players can no longer deploy structures while crafting, preventing accidental placement interruptions.

NPC Services & Rentals

  • Expanded NPC services: profession‑based name tags, voice mumbling, full kiosks with attendants for armour, restoration, and a new giga‑furnace drop‑off at Bandit Camp.
  • Rentable armour slots and restoration garages introduced at the Outpost, with rentals holding earnings for 48 hours and adjusted restoration pricing.
  • Residents receive free meals in apartments and can refill food levels to 80% at canteen NPCs; all services are accessed via dedicated UI panels and now work reliably for all players.

New Gear

  • New 40 mm Tracker Round grenade attaches to surfaces and creates a 5‑minute tracking marker on the map.

UI & Map Enhancements

  • Outpost location added to the extraction map, safe pocket indicator appears when accessing loot containers, and FPV drone UI now includes an artificial horizon showing pitch and roll.

Gameplay & Features

  • Fixed brief island disappearance when switching seamless servers, removing a visual glitch.
  • Added full FPV drone camera effects and HUD override support, enhancing drone piloting experience.
  • Enabled operating the giga furnace from a walk‑in counter and corrected booth counter displays, improving base management.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Giga Furnace is now located inside Bandit Camps, letting players use its crafting benefits within those zones.
